title: The Firmament - Vaulted Dome of the Earth
author: Zen Garcia
description: The Firmament: Vaulted Dome of the Earth by Zen Garcia (2016), an independent researcher and writer on biblical, apocryphal and Enochian themes. Taking as its starting point the 'ancient Hebrew conception of the universe' illustrated in older Bible reference works, Garcia argues that scripture describes a literal solid firmament or dome over the earth. The book works through the primeval earth as formless waste, the war in heaven and the antediluvian age, the fall of Lucifer, the first four days of creation and specific events of each, references in apocryphal and pseudepigraphal sources such as the Book of Enoch, and finally the firmament of heaven itself. It is a work of literalist biblical cosmology associated with flat-earth and 'firmament' movements, not mainstream scholarship.
